questions.question_en: A customer says their relative has passed away and they need something for the wake. Which product line is most suitable?
questions.question_zh: 客人说亲人去世，需要治丧处用的东西。最适合哪条业务线？
questions.explanation_en: Funerals, memorials and wake halls use standing wreaths and mourning baskets.
questions.explanation_zh: 丧礼、追悼会、治丧处使用庄重立式花圈与哀悼花篮。

questions.question_en: A customer is opening a new shop next week. What should you recommend?
questions.question_zh: 客人下周开新店。你应该推荐什么？
questions.explanation_en: Openings, ribbon-cuttings and new shops use large festive baskets with ribbons.
questions.explanation_zh: 开幕、剪彩、新店使用大型喜庆花篮与祝贺布条。

questions.question_en: Someone wants flowers for a proposal. Which line fits best?
questions.question_zh: 有人想要求婚用的花。哪条业务线最合适？
questions.explanation_en: Proposals, birthdays and anniversaries are for refined bouquets.
questions.explanation_zh: 求婚、生日、纪念日属于精致花束。

questions.question_en: A local florist needs a large quantity of roses for their own arrangements. What do you offer?
questions.question_zh: 本地花店需要大量玫瑰自己做花。你提供什么？
questions.explanation_en: Bulk flowers for local florists and planners are wholesale by pre-order.
questions.explanation_zh: 本地花店与策划的大量花材属于预订制鲜花批发。

questions.question_en: A couple needs bridal bouquet, car flowers and an arch with full setup. Which service?
questions.question_zh: 新人需要手捧花、婚车和拱门并要求全案布置。属于哪项服务？
questions.explanation_en: Bridal items, arches and on-site setup are wedding and event full design.
questions.explanation_zh: 手捧花、拱门与现场布置属于婚礼与活动全案设计。

questions.question_en: Customer asks for flowers for Mother’s Day. Suitable line?
questions.question_zh: 客人要母亲节的花。适合哪条？
questions.explanation_en: Mother’s Day, Valentine’s and birthdays use refined bouquets.
questions.explanation_zh: 母亲节、情人节、生日使用精致花束。

questions.question_en: A customer is moving into a new house and wants a congratulatory arrangement. What to recommend?
questions.question_zh: 客人乔迁新居，想要祝贺的摆设。推荐什么？
questions.explanation_en: Housewarmings and openings use large festive baskets.
questions.explanation_zh: 乔迁与开幕使用大型喜庆花篮。

questions.question_en: An event planner needs bulk foliage for multiple tables. Which product line?
questions.question_zh: 活动团队需要大量叶材做桌花。属于哪条业务线？
questions.explanation_en: Bulk flowers and foliage for event teams are wholesale.
questions.explanation_zh: 活动团队的散装鲜花与叶材属于鲜花批发。

questions.question_en: A customer sends a photo and says “make it exactly like this”. What is the correct rule?
questions.question_zh: 客人发图说“照这张做”。正确规则是什么？
options_en: Treat as style reference and inform that flowers adjust by season
options_zh: 当作风格参考并告知花材会依当季调整
questions.explanation_en: Guest photos are style reference only; materials and colours adjust to seasonal supply and must be told first.
questions.explanation_zh: 客人给图只能做风格参考，花材与颜色依当季供应调整，必须先告诉客人。

questions.question_en: Why must you tell the customer about photo limitations first?
questions.question_zh: 为什么必须先告诉客人图片的限制？
options_en: To avoid misunderstanding because finished product adjusts by season
options_zh: 避免误会，因为成品依当季花材调整
questions.explanation_en: Display images are reference only; finished products follow seasonal flowers.
questions.explanation_zh: 展示图片仅供参考，成品依当季花材调整。

questions.question_en: A customer wants a bouquet exactly matching a Pinterest photo. Your reply should include:
questions.question_zh: 客人要花束完全照Pinterest图。你的回复应包含：
options_en: Style reference only, seasonal adjustment will be confirmed
options_zh: 仅风格参考，当季调整会先确认
questions.explanation_en: Must inform that it is style reference and materials adjust by season.
questions.explanation_zh: 必须告知仅风格参考，花材依当季调整。

questions.question_en: Which statement about reference photos is correct?
questions.question_zh: 关于参考图，哪句正确？
options_en: Style reference only, must inform customer of seasonal changes
options_zh: 仅风格参考，必须告知当季调整
questions.explanation_en: Reference rule: style only, adjust by season, tell the guest first.
questions.explanation_zh: 参考图规则：风格参考，依当季调整，必须先告知。

questions.question_en: Customer says “the photo has blue hydrangeas, can you do blue?” Correct approach?
questions.question_zh: 客人说“图里是蓝色绣球，可以做蓝色吗？”正确做法？
options_en: Explain it depends on seasonal supply and confirm first
options_zh: 说明视当季供应，先确认
questions.explanation_en: Colours and materials adjust to seasonal supply; never invent stock.
questions.explanation_zh: 颜色与花材依当季供应调整，绝不虚构库存。

questions.question_en: What should you never do with a customer’s reference photo?
questions.question_zh: 对客人的参考图，你绝不应该做什么？
options_en: Promise exact copy and invent matching stock
options_zh: 承诺一模一样并虚构库存
questions.explanation_en: Never invent inventory; photos are style reference only.
questions.explanation_zh: 绝不虚构库存；图片仅风格参考。

questions.question_en: In a WhatsApp reply about a photo, which phrase is appropriate?
questions.question_zh: WhatsApp回复图片时，哪句合适？
options_en: We will make it 100% the same
This is for style reference; I’ll check seasonal flowers and confirm with you
options_zh: 这是风格参考；我会确认当季花材再跟你说
questions.explanation_en: Must state it is style reference and confirm seasonal supply.
questions.explanation_zh: 必须说明是风格参考并确认当季供应。

questions.question_en: Customer says “I saw negative reviews on Google”. Best reply?
questions.question_zh: 客人说“我在Google看到负评”。最好回复？
options_en: We focus on fresh flowers and on-time service; I can help confirm any specific issue
options_zh: 我们专注新鲜与准时；有具体问题我帮你确认
questions.explanation_en: Be honest, do not badmouth others, offer to confirm with company.
questions.explanation_zh: 诚实回答，不贬低别人，可协助跟公司确认。

questions.question_en: Customer worries “Will the flowers not be fresh?” Correct explanation?
questions.question_zh: 客人担心“花会不会不新鲜？”正确说明？
options_en: Air freight to Kuching airport with clearance; pre-order and inventory reduce waste
options_zh: 古晋机场空运清关；预订制与盘点减少损耗
questions.explanation_en: Explain the import process, air freight and pre-order system.
questions.explanation_zh: 说明自行处理进口、空运直采与预订盘点减少损耗。

questions.question_en: Customer asks for the exact price. What do you say?
questions.question_zh: 客人问确切价格。你怎么说？
options_en: Price follows the current quote; I'll request it for you
options_zh: 价格以当下报价为准，我帮你申请
questions.explanation_en: Never invent prices; you request the current quote in the App.
questions.explanation_zh: 绝不编造价格；一律由你在App申请当下报价。

questions.question_en: Customer says the price is too high. Appropriate response?
questions.question_zh: 客人说价格太高。合适回应？
options_en: Explain current quote process and value of freshness without promising lower price
options_zh: 说明当下报价流程与新鲜价值，不承诺降价
questions.explanation_en: Stay honest, do not invent discounts or badmouth; refer to current quote.
questions.explanation_zh: 保持诚实，不虚构折扣或贬低他人；引导当下报价。

questions.question_en: On freshness, which point is true?
questions.question_zh: 关于新鲜度，哪点是事实？
options_en: Company handles import documents and uses Kuching airport air freight
options_zh: 公司自行处理进口文件并使用古晋机场空运
questions.explanation_en: Import documents handled by company; air freight direct clearance at Kuching airport.
questions.explanation_zh: 公司自行处理进口文件；古晋机场空运直采清关。

questions.question_en: If you do not know the answer to an objection, what should you say?
questions.question_zh: 如果对异议不确定答案，应该说什么？
options_en: I will help confirm with the company
questions.explanation_en: When uncertain, say you will confirm with the company; do not invent.
questions.explanation_zh: 不确定时说帮跟公司确认；绝不编造。

questions.question_en: Customer mentions a negative review about delivery. Best action?
questions.question_zh: 客人提到负评说配送问题。最好做法？
options_en: Acknowledge, focus on our on-time principle and offer to confirm details
options_zh: 承认关注，强调准时原则并协助确认细节
questions.explanation_en: Do not badmouth; be honest and offer to confirm with company.
questions.explanation_zh: 不贬低他人；诚实并协助跟公司确认。

questions.question_en: You hear a neighbour’s shop is opening. What opportunity is this?
questions.question_zh: 你听到邻居店铺开幕。这是什么商机？
questions.explanation_en: Openings are opportunities for festive baskets.
questions.explanation_zh: 开幕是开张花篮的商机。

questions.question_en: A friend mentions their wedding next month. Which lead to pursue?
questions.question_zh: 朋友提到下个月婚礼。应该跟进哪条？
questions.explanation_en: Weddings are leads for full design and setup.
questions.explanation_zh: 婚礼是全案设计与布置的商机。

questions.question_en: Someone’s birthday is coming. Suitable opportunity?
questions.question_zh: 有人生日快到了。适合的商机？
questions.explanation_en: Birthdays are refined bouquet occasions.
questions.explanation_zh: 生日是精致花束的场合。

questions.question_en: You meet a wedding planner who often needs volume. What lead is this?
questions.question_zh: 你遇到经常需要大量花材的婚礼策划。这是什么商机？
questions.explanation_en: Planners needing bulk are wholesale leads.
questions.explanation_zh: 需要大量的策划是鲜花批发商机。

questions.question_en: A family is preparing for a memorial service. Which opportunity?
questions.question_zh: 一个家庭正在准备追悼会。哪项商机？
questions.explanation_en: Memorials and wakes are condolence wreath opportunities.
questions.explanation_zh: 追悼会与治丧是帛事花圈商机。

questions.question_en: Valentine’s Day is approaching. What should you look for?
questions.question_zh: 情人节快到了。你应该留意什么商机？
questions.explanation_en: Valentine’s is a refined bouquet occasion.
questions.explanation_zh: 情人节是精致花束场合。

questions.question_en: A new exhibition is being set up. Possible lead?
questions.question_zh: 有新展会正在筹备。可能的商机？
questions.explanation_en: Exhibitions can use large festive baskets.
questions.explanation_zh: 展会可使用大型喜庆花篮。

questions.question_en: Which of these is NOT a typical lead for refined bouquets?
questions.question_zh: 以下哪项通常不是精致花束的商机？
questions.explanation_en: Funeral wakes use condolence wreaths, not refined bouquets.
questions.explanation_zh: 丧礼治丧使用帛事花圈，不是精致花束。
